Subject: AV routing + street-level loading details for May 18 workshop

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for choosing The Galleria for your May 18 executive workshop. A few technical items came up while our tech team reviewed the footprint for Level 2. Please confirm the following so we can lock rack space, loading dock windows, and provide the correct network/LAN feeds: 

- Do you need two dedicated rack units in our comms closet (RU 21-22)? Our default includes power and patch panels but not pre-provisioned fiber.
- Preferred audio transport: Dante over AES67 (multicast) or local analog snake? If Dante, we need VLAN tagging and an L3 route for RTP to your site VPN.
- Will you require a stage mic matrix with 2x Sennheiser handhelds + 4 lapel mics?
- Do you want our onsite Wi‑Fi (guest-ssid-isolate) or a wired breakout for the control network? We can reserve an isolated VLAN for control/streaming.
- Preferred time for loading dock: 06:30–08:30 or 09:00–11:00 on 05/17 (vendor load-in)?

I've attached the Level 2 floorplan and a first-pass signal path diagram — these are drafts, not final. Once you confirm tech choices, we will provide final cable schedules and a quote.

Attachments: [floorplan_level2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [av_signal_path_v2.png (PNG, 450KB)]

Regards,
Chris Morales
Venue Operations Manager
The Galleria Conference Center

Hi Chris — thanks for the quick review and the diagrams. Quick answers below; will follow up with a short walkthrough agenda by EOD: 

- Rack units: Yes, please reserve RU 21-22 with two PDU lines. We'll bring a 1U compute box and a 1U network appliance (for NAT/VPN).
- Audio transport: Dante preferred. We will bring a Dante-enabled mixer. We need multicast across the venue VLAN plus an L3 route for RTP back to our private VPC when streaming. Can you confirm ACL controls?
- Mics: Confirm stage matrix with the mics listed. We'll bring two spare handhelds.
- Network: Please provision an isolated wired VLAN for control and streaming. We'll provide IP blocks — see below.
- Loading dock: 06:30–08:30 on 05/17 works best for our vendors.

Karthik/Laura — can you confirm the CIDR we should hand off to Galleria for the L3 route? Karthik, if you can also call out any firewall/NAT concerns, that would help their ops team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Program Lead, Events — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Galleria Ops <ops@galleria.events>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AV routing + street-level loading details for May 18 workshop

Hi all — technical follow-up. Apologies for the quick notes but wanted to get the network specifics in writing: 

- Redwood will hand off 10.91.48.0/26 for the control/streaming VLAN at the site. Please NAT outbound to your internet egress IP 54.33.210.140 (or we can peer over a site-to-site VPN).
- For Dante multicast, allow UDP 1731 and the multicast range 239.255.0.0/16 on the isolated VLAN. We'll reduce TTL to prevent cross-floor leaks.
- RTP streaming endpoint: srt://stream-in.redwood.com:9000 (SRT preferred but we can fall back to RTP over UDP). If SRT, you'll need to open 9000 TCP/UDP and agree on passphrase — I'll provide it in a secure channel once we contract.
- ACLs: Block inter-VLAN traffic except to the control host (10.91.48.5), and permit NTP and DNS to our internal resolvers (10.91.0.10).

Laura — please confirm the on-site contact for vendor check-in and give them the loading dock gate code. Chris — can you confirm whether RU 21-22 have fiber patch panels accessible, or if we'll need to bring MPO/LC patch gear?

Cheers,
Karthik
Lead Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Galleria Ops <ops@galleria.events>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AV routing + street-level loading details for May 18 workshop

Marissa/Karthik/Laura —

Thanks for the details. Quick confirmations: 

- RU 21-22 reserved and two PDUs available. We do have LC patch panels in RU21 (single-mode, 1x9). If you need MPO, bring an adapter.
- We can provision the 10.91.48.0/26 on an isolated VLAN and will set multicast allow for 239.255.0.0/16 on that VLAN. We'll also add the ACLs Karthik requested — NTP/DNS allowed to your resolvers.
- Dock code for vendor load-in (05/17, 06:30–08:30): GALL-9931. Please have vendors bring a government-issued ID for building security.
- SRT: we support SRT but require that passphrase exchange happen over DocuSign or an encrypted channel for logging reasons.

I've attached a revised quote with a modest jump for the dedicated VLAN and two PDUs. If Redwood approves, we can finalize contract and reserve the time slots.

Attachments: [vendor_quote_galleria.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]
